lines.en: I scurry along the tree roots.
My belly brushes the fallen leaves.
I pause, then dart on.
Four little legs run fast.
I slip through a narrow gap.
I sniff the ground as I go.
My tail trails behind me.
I skirt the flowers for the shade.
I hug the trunk and look up.
I cross a patch of loose soil.

lines.zh: 我绕了一个小圈再靠近。
lines.en: I circle once before closing in.
I walk in your footprints.
I wash my face with my paws.
My ears swivel this way and that.
I crouch, watching gaps in the trees.
I sniff my own tail.

lines.zh: 我在树根下刨了个浅坑。
lines.en: I scrape a shallow hollow by the roots.
I twitch my whiskers.
A breadcrumb would be enough.

lines.zh: 我竖起耳朵，听落叶下的动静。
lines.en: I prick my ears toward the rustle under the leaves.

lines.zh: 我在落叶下缩成一小团。
lines.en: I curl into a small ball under the leaves.
Sun warms my back.
I groom my whiskers.
I'm waiting for you to look away.
A leaf moves and I freeze.
I yawn, showing tiny teeth.

lines.zh: 你袋口露出种子的尖儿。
lines.en: A seed tip peeks from your pocket.
I'm this close and still haven't run.
What's in your hand?
I smell grain.
Stand still and I'll come near.
Your boots look new.
I cock my head at you.
Don't reach out suddenly.
Your shadow is huge.

lines.zh: 你手上的麦粒味，我记住了。
lines.en: I remember the smell of wheat on your hands.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的口袋，后腿绷紧。
lines.en: I fix on your pocket, hind legs tense.
Shall we make a deal?
I got pinned.
My tail hurts badly.
I've been through your seed pouch.
I squeeze into a root gap.
No more feet, please.
One of my legs won't obey.
I shiver in a corner.
I let out a squeak.
I didn't deserve that.
I can still run.
Are those seeds?
Put it down and don't move.
I smell sweet berries.

lines.zh: 甜浆果的汁，滴进我胡须里。
lines.en: Sweet berry juice drips into my whiskers.
Whatever's in your palm smells wrong.
May I take a little?
I'm close now, by your feet.
Don't close your hand.
Where did you get that?
I want to hide it away at once.
Your boot nearly crushed me.

lines.zh: 你的靴子把我踢得滚了半圈。
lines.en: Your boot sends me rolling half a turn.
I slip past your foot.

lines.zh: 老鼠的细尾巴，被鞋底压住。
lines.en: A mouse's thin tail, pinned under your boot.
Don't poke me.
You're heavy, the ground rattles.

lines.zh: 我从你的两脚之间穿过去。
lines.en: I run between your feet.
At that bump I leap away.
I left a mark on your boot.
You step back, I bolt.
First let me see what you've gathered.
There are many of my kind here.

lines.zh: 想追我，先追上我的尾巴。
lines.en: If you want me, catch my tail first.
I'm timid.
That needs a quiet corner.
I only know my own nest.
Come back when the sweet berries ripen.
I'm not even full yet.
Is there a cat? I smell a cat.
Another time, I'm off.
One seed lasts me a while.
I carry it at the corner of my mouth.
I stuff it into my cheek.
Something good fell on the ground.

lines.zh: 你包里那袋种子，归我了。
lines.en: That bag of seeds is mine.

lines.zh: 你的种子，我已经叼走两颗。
lines.en: I already nipped two of your seeds.
Too heavy, I can't drag it.
Don't tell the others.
I sniff it, a bit damp.
Wait a bit, I'll keep it.
Your pack is open.
I only need a little.
You looked away. Good.
I see seeds in your bag.
I'm approaching, hold still.
Don't lower your hand.
There's only one chance.
That seed is mine tonight.
You bowed your head, now.
Take it and go, leave no trace.
The bag isn't tied shut.
Your foot moved away.
I circle behind you.
Don't turn, just a bit more.
I wait for you to stoop lower.
I hug the ground, unseen.
Your sleeve covers the bag.
I'll go around the other side.
I count your breaths.
Your hands never stop moving.
One more breath.
The wind has shifted.
I slide along the roots.
You're still looking over there.
One reach and it's done.
I know I can't fight you.
I only want that seed.
Let me get half a step closer.
Good, you turned away.
I bit you.
My teeth are small but sharp.
I kick off with my hind legs.
I dart past your hand.

lines.zh: 我咬住你指头，转身就溜。
lines.en: I nip your finger and dart away.
That startled you, didn't it?
I leap down with the prize.
Bits of grass cling to me.
That bite wasn't hard.
I'm slipping away now.
I lunge and bite the bag's edge.

lines.zh: 我拿爪子扒着你的袖子。
lines.en: I scrabble at your sleeve.
You shake your hand and I fly off.
I land, roll, and run.
I pop out from the roots.
A leaf rustled, that was me.

lines.zh: 我从树根下钻出，胡须沾着土。
lines.en: I emerge from under a root, whiskers dusty.
The forest gains a small shadow.
My whiskers twitch, I move on.
I take three sniffs first.
I look upwind.

lines.zh: 这里有很多能吃的东西。
lines.en: Plenty here to eat.
I tuck my tail and stand ready.
My tiny claws scrape the bark.
With light I can see.
I poke my head out cautiously.

lines.zh: 猫头鹰刚走，我才敢出来。
lines.en: The owl just left; only now do I dare come out.
I'm here, don't step on me.
Among these shadows, I'm the smallest.
I smell seeds.
Fire singed my fur into curls.

lines.zh: 我偷来的种子撒了一地。
lines.en: The seeds I stole scattered everywhere.

lines.zh: 水进了鼻子，我直打喷嚏。
lines.en: Water up my nose, I sneeze hard.

lines.zh: 爆炸把耳朵震得嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The blast left my ears buzzing.
An arrow pins me to the ground.
A flash and my fur stands on end.

lines.zh: 你包里的种子，我拿走了。
lines.en: The seeds in your pack — taken.
Lightning strikes, my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有树根可以钻。
lines.en: No roots to hide in, in the void.
